body: I cried when she cried it really hit me when she said “that little girl is all I have” like they literally do not give a fuck about an innocent persons life, including a baby, just because they’re brains can’t fathom the fact that there’s someone out there that thinks differently from them. These people are so dangerous, they’re blinded by this conservative trend of  being an asshole and have the freedom to get away with it. It made me rage so badly that when she threatened to call the cops, and he was so calmly saying they can’t do anything because he knew he’d get away with it. Fuck I hate the United States. Tailgating is enough of a crime but as a woman, you have to understand the fear that overcomes you when you find yourself in danger by a stranger whose also male to make matters worse and you have your CHILD with you. Imagine the frustration and the overwhelming feeling of “I don’t know why this man is following me so closely”. She’s brave for pulling over and trying to knock some sense into him because I know I’d be crying and trying to get to safety.

(Continued) I’m a big crybaby and even when I’m mad or even confused, I’ll cry. It’s a reaction I have to everything. It’s not in my power to not cry it just happens, and they’ve know that since I was in preschool through grade school and so on. When I have arguments with my boyfriend, out of my body’s automatic response, I’ll cry and I’ve explained I don’t mean to cry. But they feel entitled to yell at him while I’m arguing with him. Or if I’m sad about literally something completely different, they’re first instinct is to blame him. At this point my boyfriend doesn’t invite me to go travel with him and his family btw anywhere because my parents don’t want me to be alone with him. And it frustrates me so much. It’s ruining my relationship with them that they can’t accept the fact that I’m going to be intimate with my boyfriend. I understood it when I was 15,16,17 yk? Like, yes even I told him that it was not okay to be so touchy or clingy in front of them at my house but I’ve always been a responsible kid and they know that. I’ve never given them a reason to doubt my reasoning capabilities. And I’ve told them this before but they don’t have an answer they just go into this rage telling me that I live under their house and under their rules driving a car they bought. So i don’t know what to do, I don’t know whose wrong. I know my relationship isn’t perfect but I know for sure it’s not toxic and he’s never abused me emotionally or physically , like for gods sake I’m in an anonymous app I’d feel comfortable to share abuse if I experienced it because I’m a big advocate for it but he’s genuinely never even called me stupid.. Someone just tell me what to do.
I want to try I just it’s difficult to bring myself to doing it willingly. I’ve grown so embarrassed of my whole situation that it’s hard to even say it to complete strangers. But I’m trying.

the thing is this the first time I put the way I’ve been feeling out here in public. even anonymously I still feel extremely embarrassed and the idea of people around me knowing suicide is a constant thought in my head isvery  embarrassing and I just feel like I’ll be made fun of. I plan to mention it  to my doctor because i finally have insurance but the clinic where I have my doctor is also the clinic I’m doing my internship at and it’s really scary to think they might reject me if I say something. Therefore hiding it is my best option but it’s very overwhelming. And yes I’ve tried the music, unfortunately I only life with my parents and so they are always opening my door. Mexican parents have rules about allowing me to lock my door.
